verdict.rationale: PlanetScale exposes a programmatic API (docs-49) and a CLI with create/delete/list commands and non-interactive SQL execution for scripts/agents (docs-41, docs-17), which could be scripted to act on many items, but there is no documented bulk/batch endpoint or explicit 'operate on N items at once' feature for databases, branches, or schema changes. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API operations (e.g., batch create/delete of branches or databases in one call), documented examples of an agent performing multi-item bulk actions, independent confirmation of bulk workflows at scale.
